svg.title: Figure 6. Supplied CytExpert gating screenshot. Left: FSC-A/SSC-A from All Events with P1. Middle: FSC-A/FSC-H with parent P1 and child P2. Right: an ECD-A histogram with parent P2. The displayed 45.30% and 86.25% have different parent denominators; neither is a viability measurement. The screenshot's sample identity is unconfirmed and its gates are not a validated 293T template.
